messages:
liam: opened a PR to refresh the Console observability guide: replace legacy trace header examples with W3C trace context and modernize dashboard/widget examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — need review for snippets and migration checklist.

_docs-bot: PR opened by @liam — automated checks: linkcheck FAILED (1 bad dashboard URL), spellcheck OK, preview build queued._

sophia: reviewing. couple of things I noticed: the old examples still reference `X-Cloud-Trace-Context` and the dashboard JSON uses `service` as group key. In prod we now index by `service_path` and we renamed token billing metric to `token_cost_per_1k_tokens`. Please update examples to match telemetry.

harper: for trace examples, we should show adding `traceparent` at the request level for clarity. I'll draft both Python and TS snippets showing request-level header injection and a tiny note about trace-id formatting. Also add a short troubleshooting blurb about proxies stripping headers.

chris: suggested TS snippet (per-request):
```ts
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-ai/sdk'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })

const resp = await client.chat.create({
  model: 'redwood-chat-7b',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'status?' }],
  headers: { traceparent: '00-11111111111111111111111111111111-2222222222222222-01' }
})
console.log(resp.text)
```

harper: Python snippet I'll add mirrors this but with os.getenv and a short comment about trace-id length.

liam: nice. can we also provide a compact widget JSON that people can paste? i want it to highlight cost-per-1k and tail latency. something minimal so it doesn't scare less-technical readers.

sophia: here's a compact widget example that fits that ask (using current metric keys):
```json
{
  "type": "cost_latency_summary",
  "metrics": ["token_cost_per_1k_tokens","latency_ms_p90","latency_ms_p99"],
  "group_by": ["service_path","model"],
  "window": "14d"
}
```

chris: couple editorial nits: use `token_cost_per_1k_tokens` in the billing paragraph, and add a small migration table at the top mapping old keys -> new keys (old: `token_cost`, `service` -> new: `token_cost_per_1k_tokens`, `service_path`). Keep it 2-3 lines.

harper: added sampling note: hosted traces default to 1% sampling (0.01). If you need higher sample rates for debugging, file an infra ticket. Also added: "If traces don't show up, verify that intermediary proxies are not dropping the `traceparent` header and that sampling is enabled for your org."

_docs-bot: linkcheck re-run: dashboard URL fixed by @sophia. code-lint reports a long line in the TS snippet (line > 120 chars). Build preview available._

liam: I'll shorten the long line and push. action items: (1) harper - add Python snippet + short trace-id example and W3C link (2) sophia - insert migration mini-table and replace dashboard example (3) chris - editorial pass and final wording. target: merge after preview passes, aim EOD. :rocket:

chris: quick confirmation — Console expects a 32-hex trace-id in the `traceparent` second field. I'll include that example and link to the spec: https://www.w3.org/TR/trace-context/

harper: pushed Python snippet and small trace-id example line. shortened TS long line as requested. force-pushed.

_docs-bot: all checks passed. Preview deployed.

liam: thanks everyone. I'll merge once I get two approvals in the PR. ping me if you want to pair on any wording. :thumbsup:
